summary: Implementation plan for the dedicated Music & Discography Downloader in Klyp. Outlines sidebar navigation separation, hybrid iTunes and MusicBrainz metadata integration, discography grouping (Studio Albums, EPs, Singles), 30-second audio previews, tracklist batch selection, and high-fidelity MP3/FLAC download engine with embedded high-resolution album art and ID3v2/FLAC Vorbis tags.
